verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own automatic user provisioning: changes made to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to connected third-party apps, which covers part of the app-by-app choreography on identity changes. Apps Script is a low-code building block rather than event-triggered no-code workflows, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented no-code workflow builder triggered by identity events, explicit hire/role-change/departure workflow templates, multi-step cross-app orchestration beyond account sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, identity events trigger automation — no-code workflows on hire, role change, and departure handle the app-by-app choreography for me

citations.quote: Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
אתם יכולים להגדיר הקצאת הרשאות אוטומטית למשתמשים כדי שכל השינויים שתבצעו בחשבונות המשתמשים ב-Google Workspace יסונכרנו אוטומטית עם אפליקציית הצד השלישי הזאת.
